levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن أبي ثور

notes: Ibn Abbas asks Umar and Umar answers («فقال واعجبي لك يا ابن عباس»), then Umar tells the story himself («ثم استقبل عمر الحديث يسوقه»): Umar is the last link (rules 5, 6)
the long matn is Umar's narrative; the wives and the Ansar are its subject, not links
